name: Accelera

voice.register: plain, concrete, no hype, no em-dashes, no emoji, owner-operator credible
do: owner language: 'book a job', 'missed calls', 'average ticket', 'on the roof', 'after hours', 'wife/partner'
active voice only: 'We build' not 'Your site will be built'
grade 5-7 reading level for landing pages
one idea per sentence, max 20 words
CTA next to the approve-before-launch line; guarantee only once Tyler approves it
dont: no em-dashes, no parentheticals, no emoji
no jargon: SEO, SERP, conversion, funnel, onboarding, dashboard, portal, SaaS, platform, implementation
no hype words: leverage, unlock, revolutionary, next-gen, game-changing
no vendor marketing claims: '62% unanswered', '$126K lost per year'
nothing fabricated: no fake reviews, logos, or clients

source: logo: /Users/TylerMaxwell/Downloads/Accelera Long Logo.png; voice: PLAN.md + MESSAGE-MAP.md
colors_note: 2026-11-15: Tyler chose the blue + orange Accelera colors (navy #0A1929/#1A2A47 + vibrant orange #FF6B00 from his original brand docs, reference/business-docs/systems-draft-guide.md). Replaces blue #2B67BD / green #00A859. Orange buttons take navy text (white on #FF6B00 is 2.9:1, fails WCAG).
